# Adam Peleback

> Frontend Developer, QA Engineer, Esports Tournament Organizer, and Copywriter based in Stockholm, Sweden.

Adam Peleback is a Stockholm-based software professional with over seven years of experience across frontend engineering, quality assurance, esports infrastructure, and written content. He builds modern web applications and esports platforms with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and is available for freelance and full-time engagements in software development and QA engineering.

## Services

- Web Development — React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js. Responsive, SEO-optimised, performance-first applications.
- Test Automation — Unit, integration, end-to-end, and CI/CD pipeline testing. Previously led QA work at G-Loot.
- Discord Bot Development — Custom bots for moderation, role management, game integration, and community automation.
- Esports Tournament Administration — Bracket management, team coordination, prize pool administration, and event scheduling.
- Copywriting — Event pages, news articles, sponsorship proposals, and esports written content.
